OpenWeatherMap API를 사용하는 디스코드 봇을 만들 예정입니다:
- **bot.py**: 메인 봇 파일 (명령어: `/서울날씨`, `/서울_상세날씨`)
- **requirements.txt**: 필요한 패키지 (discord.py, aiohttp, python-dotenv)
- **.env.example**: 토큰 설정 템플릿

1. **Slash 명령어** (최신 Discord 방식)
2. **OpenWeatherMap API** (무료, 상세 정보 제공)

import discord
from discord.ext import commands
import aiohttp
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

intents = discord.Intents.default()
intents.message_content = True

bot = commands.Bot(command_prefix='!', intents=intents)

OPENWEATHER_API_KEY = os.getenv('OPENWEATHER_API_KEY')
DISCORD_TOKEN = os.getenv('DISCORD_TOKEN')
\<EMAIL>
async def on_ready():
    print(f'{bot.user} has connected to Discord!')
    try:
        synced = await bot.tree.sync()
        print(f"Synced {len(synced)} command(s)")
    except Exception as e:
        print(e)
\<EMAIL>(name="서울날씨", description="서울의 현재 날씨를 알려줍니다")
async def seoul_weather(interaction: discord.Interaction):
    """서울의 날씨 정보를 조회합니다"""
    
    if not OPENWEATHER_API_KEY:
        await interaction.response.send_message("❌ API 키가 설정되지 않았습니다.")
        return
    
    await interaction.response.defer()
    
    try:
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            url = f"https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=Seoul&appid={OPENWEATHER_API_KEY}&units=metric&lang=ko"
            async with session.get(url) as response:
                if response.status == 200:
                    data = await response.json()
                    
                    temp = data['main']['temp']
                    feels_like = data['main']['feels_like']
                    humidity = data['main']['humidity']
                    pressure = data['main']['pressure']
                    wind_speed = data['wind']['speed']
                    description = data['weather'][0]['description']
                    
                    weather_type = data['weather'][0]['main']
                    emoji_map = {
                        'Clear': '☀️',
                        'Clouds': '☁️',
                        'Rain': '🌧️',
                        'Drizzle': '🌦️',
                        'Thunderstorm': '⛈️',
                        'Snow': '❄️',
                        'Mist': '🌫️',
                    }
                    emoji = emoji_map.get(weather_type, '🌤️')
                    
                    embed = discord.Embed(
                        title=f"{emoji} 서울의 날씨",
                        color=discord.Color.blue()
                    )
                    embed.add_field(name="🌡️ 현재 온도", value=f"{temp}°C", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="🤔 체감 온도", value=f"{feels_like}°C", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="💧 습도", value=f"{humidity}%", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="🌪️ 바람 속도", value=f"{wind_speed} m/s", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="📊 기압", value=f"{pressure} hPa", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="☁️ 날씨", value=description.capitalize(), inline=True)
                    embed.set_footer(text="OpenWeatherMap API")
                    
                    await interaction.followup.send(embed=embed)
                else:
                    await interaction.followup.send("❌ 날씨 정보를 가져오지 못했습니다.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        await interaction.followup.send(f"❌ 오류가 발생했습니다: {str(e)}")
\<EMAIL>(name="서울_상세날씨", description="서울의 상세한 날씨 정보를 알려줍니다")
async def seoul_detailed_weather(interaction: discord.Interaction):
    """서울의 상세 날씨 정보를 조회합니다"""
    
    if not OPENWEATHER_API_KEY:
        await interaction.response.send_message("❌ API 키가 설정되지 않았습니다.")
        return
    
    await interaction.response.defer()
    
    try:
        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            url = f"https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=Seoul&appid={OPENWEATHER_API_KEY}&units=metric&lang=ko"
            async with session.get(url) as response:
                if response.status == 200:
                    data = await response.json()
                    
                    temp = data['main']['temp']
                    temp_min = data['main']['temp_min']
                    temp_max = data['main']['temp_max']
                    feels_like = data['main']['feels_like']
                    humidity = data['main']['humidity']
                    pressure = data['main']['pressure']
                    wind_speed = data['wind']['speed']
                    wind_deg = data['wind'].get('deg', 'N/A')
                    clouds = data['clouds']['all']
                    visibility = data.get('visibility', 'N/A') / 1000 if data.get('visibility') else 'N/A'
                    description = data['weather'][0]['description']
                    
                    embed = discord.Embed(
                        title="📍 서울의 상세 날씨",
                        color=discord.Color.green()
                    )
                    embed.add_field(name="🌡️ 현재 온도", value=f"{temp}°C", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="📈 최고/최저", value=f"{temp_max}°C / {temp_min}°C", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="🤔 체감 온도", value=f"{feels_like}°C", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="💧 습도", value=f"{humidity}%", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="🌪️ 바람 속도", value=f"{wind_speed} m/s", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="🧭 풍향", value=f"{wind_deg}°", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="☁️ 구름", value=f"{clouds}%", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="👁️ 시정", value=f"{visibility} km" if isinstance(visibility, float) else visibility, inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="📊 기압", value=f"{pressure} hPa", inline=True)
                    embed.add_field(name="상태", value=description.capitalize(), inline=False)
                    embed.set_footer(text="OpenWeatherMap API")
                    
                    await interaction.followup.send(embed=embed)
                else:
                    await interaction.followup.send("❌ 날씨 정보를 가져오지 못했습니다.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        await interaction.followup.send(f"❌ 오류가 발생했습니다: {str(e)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if DISCORD_TOKEN:
        bot.run(DISCORD_TOKEN)
    else:
        print("❌ DISCORD_TOKEN이 설정되지 않았습니다. .env 파일을 확인하세요.")
EOF
